title: 21 Hamilton Lane - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “21 Hamilton Lane,” a stunning family-friendly retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Just a 4-minute stroll to the Cabana Pool and North Barrett Square, this home offers an outstandingly equipped kitchen, serene views of West Kingston Park
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “21 Hamilton Lane,” a stunning family-friendly retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Just a 4-minute stroll to the Cabana Pool and North Barrett Square, this home offers an outstandingly equipped kitchen, serene views of West Kingston Park, 2 Primary Suites with balconies, 6 beach cruisers, a cozy fireplace, and a private courtyard. Perfect for up to 10 guests seeking a luxurious beach getaway! Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Two Primary Suites – Both include private balconies and en suitesCozy Fireplace – Perfect for relaxing eveningsFully-Stocked Chef's Kitchen – Incredible setup for cooking and entertaining4-Minute Walk to the Cabana Pool – A tropical oasis for the familyLocation near North Barrett Square – Boutique shopping and dining 5 minutes awaySerene Park Views – Relax on your front porch overlooking West Kingston ParkBikes Included – Explore 30A with 6 provided beach cruisersDriveway Parking for 2 VehiclesShort Bike Ride to the BeachEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The home is gorgeous with everything you need. Beds were so comfy, and the location is perfect–we’ll be back!" – Kerry S.⭐ "Loved the neighborhood feel and walking distance to restaurants, pools, and shops. A dreamy getaway!" – Aimee G.⭐ "The kitchen is a gem! Fully stocked with high-quality utensils and cookware, which made meals a breeze!" – Chris O.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into an inviting open floor plan where elegant decor combines with practical design. The living room features cozy seating, a fireplace with a mounted TV, and direct access to two outdoor spaces – a serene front porch with park views and a courtyard dining area perfect for al fresco meals.Fireplace-centered living room with TVFront porch with couch seating facing West Kingston ParkDining table for 4 and grill in the courtyard*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen is a chef's dream! Enjoy top-quality cookware, bar seating for casual meals, and a beautiful dining table that can seat six. Whether you're brewing coffee in the morning or hosting dinner at night, this space has you covered.Fully stocked kitchen with premium All-Clad cookwareBarstool seating for 4 and dining table seating for 6Additional back patio with private courtyard*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Find tranquility and fun right outside. Step out from the living room to the front porch facing West Kingston Park and enjoy your morning coffee on the cozy couch. From the other living room door, access a dining table for four and a grill, perfect for outdoor meals. The private courtyard also provides extra seating for evening drinks or quiet moments. And for leisurely rides through Rosemary Beach and beyond, take advantage of the 6 included beach cruisers.Private courtyard with ample seatingFront porch with park views and cozy seatingOutdoor dining table for four and a grill6 beach cruisers to explore 30A*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Powder Room – Full laundry area and conveniently located half-bath2nd Floor:Primary Suite 1 – King bed, en suite, private balcony with park viewsPrimary Suite 2 – King bed, en suite, private balcony facing courtyardKids Bunk Room – Two twin-over-twin bunk beds, shared hallway bathroom3rd Floor Loft:Twin Bedroom – Two custom-built twin beds with cozy charm*** ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ***Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** LOCATION ***4-Min Walk to Cabana Pool5-Min Walk to North Barrett Square with Boutique Shops and RestaurantsShort Stroll or swift bike ride to Emerald Waters and Sugar-White Sands*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is currently active construction next door to this property, and we do not have a completion date at this time.The outdoor fireplace is not for guest use at this time.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 32280STRO #: STR-032280

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
